title: What Can a Recurrent State Safely Forget?
abstract: arXiv:2609.23366v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recurrent models must preserve information that changes future behavior while suppressing hidden-state error. These objectives conflict: contraction improves stability, but contraction along a future-distinguishing direction destroys memory. We formalize this boundary through the predictive quotient of a recurrent state space. Two hidden states are equivalent when they induce the same conditional future; their equivalence classes form predictive fibers. Every exact semantics-preserving corrector acts as the identity on this quotient. At a regular point with hidden dimension d and predictive dimension k, it can eliminate at most d - k independent directions. This establishes a discrete-continuous boundary: finite predictive states admit positive-radius exact correction basins, whereas an uncountable continuum of future-distinguishable states cannot be decoded after arbitrary positive-radius perturbations in finite-dimensional Euclidean sp

translated_title: 循环状态可以安全遗忘什么？
translated_abstract: 循环模型必须保留那些会改变未来行为的信息，同时抑制隐藏状态的误差。这两个目标存在冲突：收缩提升了稳定性，但沿未来区分方向的收缩会破坏记忆。我们通过循环状态空间的“预测商”来形式化这一边界。当两个隐藏状态诱导出相同的条件未来时，它们是等价的；它们的等价类构成预测纤维。每一个精确的保持语义的校正器在该商上表现为恒等映射。在具有隐藏维度 d 和预测维度 k 的正则点处，它最多可以消除 d - k 个独立方向。这建立了一个离散-连续边界：有限的预测状态允许具有正半径的精确校正盆地，而在有限维欧几里得空间中，不可数的、可区分未来的连续状态在任意正半径扰动后无法被解码。
tldr: 该论文通过“预测商”框架形式化了循环模型中记忆保持与误差抑制之间的根本边界，证明精确的语义保持校正最多只能消除 d−k 个独立方向，且有限的预测状态可被精确校正，而连续统中可区分未来的状态一旦受扰动便无法恢复。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes the fundamental boundary between memory preservation and error suppression in recurrent models via the "predictive quotient," proving that exact semantics-preserving correction can eliminate at most d−k independent directions, and that finite predictive states admit positive-radius correction basins while an uncountable continuum of future-distinguishable states cannot be decoded after perturbations.
